scheme.name: ICSI Syllabus 2022
scheme.notes: Structure from the ICSI Syllabus 2022 PDF supplied by the founder. Needs editor review before publishing. Excluded as deleted by ICSI: Paper 1 lessons 9 Law relating to Specific Relief, 12 Indian Stamp Law, 13 Law relating to Registration of Documents, 17 Law relating to Sale of Goods; Paper 1 lesson 2 topics Finance Bill and Other Bills, Parliamentary Standing Committees and their Role; Paper 1 lesson 11 topics Power of High Court to make rules, Mediation rules made by Higher Courts; Paper 2 lessons 12 Inspection, Inquiry and Investigation, 17 Corporate Social Responsibility-Concepts (ICSI relocates the topics Policy; Activities and CSR Committee into lesson 18 Annual Report-Concepts, not itemised in the syllabus text; CSR Expenditure, Ongoing Project, Impact Assessment deleted); Paper 2 lesson 10 topics Oppression and Mismanagement, Class Actions Suits; Paper 6 lessons 4 External Commercial Borrowings (ECB), 9 Law relating to Fugitive Economic Offenders, 10 Law relating to Benami Transactions & Prohibition (briefs relocated into lesson 8).
